mints_anchored.description: two-tier-accumulator: a build-up -> payoff grammar where an accumulator FILLS on one action-tier (combo-beat / stack / rune-slot / charge) and DISCHARGES on a second (invoke / spend / release), the two tiers being distinct mechanics rather than one magnitude scalar. The genre's dominant 'accumulate-then-unleash' pattern; the run's largest accrual mass (~10 kits, strengthening every basin). Engine accumulator scales a single magnitude; this needs a two-tier fill/discharge substrate.
